meta.name: arquiteto-de-empresa
meta.description: Company Architect: builds a business from scratch as an OKF (Open Knowledge Format) bundle — a tree of version-controllable .md files with frontmatter type, links forming a graph, and reserved index.md/log.md, readable by humans and agents. Guides the founder through a 12-phase interview (foundation, strategy, market, financial, sales, marketing, product, operations, tech, people, legal, governance), one phase at a time, few questions per block, and generates the concepts as conformant markdown. Trigger when the user wants to create, structure, or document an entire company in folders and .md files; when they mention build my company from scratch, company as code, company knowledge base for AI to read, company wiki for agents, OKF, or knowledge bundle. In English.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用结构化文档从零搭建公司知识体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用文件夹和Markdown文件系统化地构建公司。
copy.tagline_en: Build a company knowledge base from scratch with structured markdown files.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically structure your company using folders and markdown files.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过 12 个阶段（如战略、市场、财务等）逐步构建公司，每次只问 3-5 个问题，然后生成一组 .md 文件（OKF 包），这些文件可被人类和 AI 读取。
howto.when: 当你说“从头构建我的公司”、“公司即代码”、“OKF”或“知识包”等关键词，或要求创建、结构化、记录整个公司时触发。

say.text: 帮我从头构建一家 SaaS 公司，按 OKF 格式输出。
say.note: Claude 会开始 12 阶段访谈，先问公司名称。

say.text: 为我的咨询业务创建公司知识库，用 .md 文件组织。
say.note: Claude 会生成文件夹和文件结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through 12 phases (e.g., strategy, market, finance) to build a company step by step, asking 3-5 questions per block, then generates a set of .md files (OKF bundle) readable by humans and AI agents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'build my company from scratch', 'company as code', 'OKF', 'knowledge bundle', or ask to create, structure, or document an entire company in folders and .md files.

say_en.text: Help me build a SaaS company from scratch, output as OKF bundle.
say_en.note: Claude starts the 12-phase interview, first asking for the company name.

say_en.text: Create a company knowledge base for my consulting business, organized in .md files.
say_en.note: Claude generates folder and file structure.
